instruction: A candid lifestyle photograph capturing a full-body, eye-level shot of a young couple walking hand-in-hand down a stone city sidewalk next to a brick building with a blue storefront. On the right, the man in the pink sweater and brown beanie (R1) walks forward, holding his partner's hand with a small black camera bag slung across his chest, his gaze directed slightly downward. On the left, the woman in the white jacket and yellow-lined vest (R2) walks in step with him, holding his hand and looking toward him with a gentle, happy smile. The scene is illuminated by soft, natural daylight, creating a warm and intimate atmosphere.
